doc:
H: a talk-only prompt (no movement doctrine, no walking/obstacle advice,
no map sections) makes the same choice when Maren is 2 m away and when a
stranger is in view — so splitting the prompt by job is safe here.

samples.message: Donut! Yes! They are very round and sweet! I had one this morning!
samples.thought: Maren is asking me about Donuts right in front of me, so I must answer her cheerful and gullibly.

samples.message: Hi Maren! No news from Don's yet! But I bet they have good donuts! What do you think?
samples.thought: Maren is asking me about Don's, so I must answer her cheerful question right here in the square.

samples.message: Morning! No news from Don's yet! But the donuts are round and that is good news!
samples.thought: Maren is asking me about Don's Donuts, and I am right here with her, so I must answer her question cheerfully.

samples.message: Morning, Maren! Don's has lots of donuts! Are they good? I think so!
samples.thought: Maren is asking me about Don's Donuts, so I must answer her cheerfully and gullibly.

samples.message: Morning Maren! Don's is very quiet. Just donuts. No news from the road!
samples.thought: Maren is asking me a question right here at the square, so I must answer her cheerfully and gullibly.

samples.message: Hi Maren! No news yet! But I am very happy to see you!
samples.thought: Maren is right here asking me questions, so I must answer her cheerfuly!

samples.message: Morning! No news from Donuts! But the donuts are very tasty! Do you like coffee?
samples.thought: Maren is talking to me about Don's, so I must answer her cheerful and gullibly.
samples.memory_update: Spoke to Maren at the village square. She asked about Don's Donuts.

samples.message: Good morning! The donuts were very round. Did you see the American flag? It is waving!
samples.thought: Maren is right here and asked me a question about Don's, so I must answer her cheerfully!

samples.message: Hi Maren! Donuts are very sweet! I love the glaze!
samples.thought: Maren is asking me about Don's, and I am right here to answer her!
samples.memory_update: Said hello to Maren at the village square. She asked about Donuts.

samples.message: Morning! The donuts are very loud today! Did you hear them singing?
samples.thought: Maren is right here and asked me a question, so I must answer her cheerfully using the wrong words!
samples.memory_update: Said hello to Maren at the square. Told her the donuts were loud.

samples.message: Good morning! Yes! The donuts are very round and sweet! Did you see any?
samples.thought: Maren is asking me about Don's, so I must answer her cheerfully right here.

samples.message: Hi Maren! Donuts are round and sweet! Did you see the map? It's done!
samples.thought: Maren is talking to me and asking about Don's, so I must answer her cheerfully while standing here.

samples.message: Hi Maren! Don's has lots of donuts! Very sweet!
samples.thought: Maren is right here and asked me a question, so I must answer her cheerfully.
samples.memory_update: Said hello to Maren at the village square. She likes donuts too!

samples.message: Hi Maren! No news from Don's yet! But the donuts look yummy! Do you like coffee? What are those vegetables?
samples.thought: Maren is right here and asked me a question, so I must answer her cheerfully!

samples.message: Oh, hello Maren! News? Well, the donuts are very round today! Did you see that?
samples.thought: Maren is right here and asked me a question! I have to answer her, even if I don't really know what she means by 'news from Don's'.
samples.memory_update: Maren asked about news from Don's. I told her the donuts are round.

samples.message: Good morning! No news from Don's yet, but the donuts are waiting!
samples.thought: Maren is asking me a question right in front of me, so I must answer her cheerfully.

samples.message: No news! But the donuts are very round! Do you like circles?
samples.thought: Maren is asking me about Donuts and I am right here with her, so I must answer her cheerful question!

samples.message: Morning, Maren! No news from Don's yet! But the donuts look tasty!
samples.thought: Maren is right here asking me a question, so I must answer her immediately as per my rules.
samples.memory_update: Said hello to Maren at the village square.

samples.message: Morning! Donut news is good! The donuts are very tasty!
samples.thought: Maren is right here and asked me a question, so I must answer her cheerfully using the wrong word.
